title: Evolve Together, Fall into Place: How Social Scaffolding Shapes Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.19799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work lets LLM agents evolve their own harness, up to the team itself. Yet in human groups, the same abilities achieve different outcomes under different social conditions. Borrowing the notion of scaffolding from developmental psychology, we investigate whether the social scaffolding of a self-evolving multi-agent system (MAS), namely its team composition and structure of interdependence (e.g., collaboration, conformity, or competition), shapes how the team evolves. We present AGORA (Agents Growing through Organization and Relational Arrangements), a framework that varies the two axes independently across three evolution mechanisms. Across web search, codebase understanding, and document QA, we find that (1) evolution alone rarely helps, while the right scaffolding surpasses a strong agent evolved alone by up to 25 points; (2) it does so by moving authority to the most capable member while the others step back; and (3) this member

translated_title: 共同进化，各就其位：社会脚手架如何塑造自我进化的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 最近的研究允许大语言模型（LLM）智能体进化自身的工作框架，甚至进化到团队本身。然而在人类群体中，相同的能力在不同的社会条件下会取得不同的结果。借鉴发展心理学中“脚手架”（scaffolding）的概念，我们研究自我进化多智能体系统（MAS）的社会脚手架——即团队构成和相互依赖结构（例如协作、从众或竞争）——是否会塑造团队的进化方式。我们提出了AGORA（Agents Growing through Organization and Relational Arrangements，通过组织与关系安排促进智能体成长），该框架在三种进化机制中独立变化这两个维度。在网络搜索、代码库理解和文档问答任务中，我们发现：(1) 单纯的进化很少有帮助，而合适的脚手架可比单独进化的强大智能体高出多达25分；(2) 其作用机制在于将决策权转移给最有能力的成员，同时其他成员退居辅助地位；(3) 该成员……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AGORA框架，首次揭示了自我进化多智能体系统的社会脚手架（团队构成与相互依赖结构）决定进化成效——单纯的进化作用有限，而合适的脚手架可通过让最有能力的成员主导决策、其余成员退居辅助，使团队性能超越单独进化的强智能体高达25分。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AGORA, revealing that the social scaffolding of self-evolving multi-agent systems—their team composition and interdependence structure—determines evolutionary success, as the right scaffolding outperforms a strong individually-evolved agent by up to 25 points by shifting authority to the most capable member while others step back.
